positions.title: Undergraduate Research Full-Stack Software Developer
positions.description:
• Architected and developed a reset password feature using REST API with Python and Flask on the website with 100+ users by building a secure email notification system and adding pages for user forms using React.js.

• Designed SQLite authentication schema to support storing new reset tokens for users, allowing improved security checks such as verifying token limits and validating users by utilizing SQLAlchemy to facilitate communication. 

• Developed a pagination functionality for the authentication system, designing an API endpoint to efficiently handle data retrieval and implementing a React frontend page leveraging Next.js for a dynamic table display.

• Enhanced the authentication system by integrating Google and Github authorization by configuring client IDs and secrets and restructuring API endpoints, enabling 80% of users to sign up with ease.

• Established comprehensive tests using Pytest to handle edge cases, identifying 90% of bugs before deployment.
positions.insights: Skills: Git · Python (Programming Language) · API Development · Next.js · pytest · SQLAlchemy · Flask · Oauth2 · SQLite · React.js

projects.title: CrisisVue
projects.description:
• Developed an interactive web application for visualizing crisis events using React & Typescript, utilizing a
dependency injection model using Python with Flask backend to interface with a NoSQL database.
• Architected a search aggregation pipeline in the MongoDB database, leveraging PyMongo, to filter user
requested events on the frontend, boosting search efficiency by up to 50%.
• Integrated Google Firebase for admin functionality, including event data management and user authentication.
• Implemented explorable map visualization using Leaflet.js, accurately representing 20+ geographical data points
